jobs.input: one complete 104-row policy run manifest composed by the frozen cross-fitted rule
jobs.attempt: a model-free derivative bound to the finalized matched-attempt identity; scoring does not reopen or mutate that attempt

materialization: No scorer starts until observation, matched, shuffled-evidence, and resend attempts are sealed and the three wave-1 complete 104-row manifests verify. The launcher writes exact manifest paths to a JSONL job file and invokes the unchanged official finalizer once per manifest. Wave 2 starts only after the fixed cross-fitted policy composition has produced and verified its own complete derivative manifest; it invokes score rather than finalize because it makes no model contact and reuses the already-finalized matched-attempt identity.
aggregation_rule: Never split one dataset into scoring shards and never average shard-level metrics. Each worker invokes the unchanged official scorer on one complete 104-row composite.
equivalence_rule: Every result must be verified, bind the expected complete-manifest identity, and match the unchanged authoritative single-job path for the same manifest after excluding nonsemantic timing fields.
timing_receipt: Each batch-summary.json records outer wall time, sum of per-job elapsed times, effective speedup, worker count, per-job status, scorer identity, complete-manifest identities, and result hashes.
